chose: serve.mjs sends a stream-json channel_enable control request once the poller is alive, retrying each poller check
over: a warm-up model turn at startup
exiting so systemd restarts when enable is refused
because: channel_enable registers handlers with no turn (verified on 2.1.302); a warm-up costs a turn per restart; exiting would restart-loop and stop dispatch if the control protocol changes

chose: install-units restarts glissa.service before the timers
because: a timer firing before the service is up dispatches into a missing socket and the watch alert pages falsely on every deploy
journals are Coherence records of sessions, not sources an install reads, and every session branch name carries the harness name
